title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 26: the doorkeepers and their gates, the keepers of the treasures, and the officers over Israel.

questions.text: Meshelemiah, of the Korahites, was the son of whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:1 names Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the Korahites.

questions.text: Who was the firstborn son of Meshelemiah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:2 says Meshelemiah's sons were Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, and so on.

questions.text: What reason does the text give after listing the eight sons of Obed-Edom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:5 ends the list of Obed-Edom's sons with the words "for God blessed him."

answers.text: He was a mighty man of war
He had served the priests for forty years

questions.text: Why was Shimri the chief among the sons of Hosah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:10 says that though Shimri was not the firstborn, his father made him chief.

answers.text: The lot fell on him first

questions.text: Where did the lot of Zechariah, a wise counselor, come out?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:14 says the lot of Zechariah, a wise counselor, came out northward.

questions.text: Obed-Edom received the south. What was given to his sons?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:15 says the lot was to Obed-Edom southward, and to his sons the storehouse.

answers.text: The treasures of the dedicated things

questions.text: What did they dedicate to repair Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:27 says they dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair Yahweh's house.

answers.text: Gold sent by the king of Egypt
The crown of the king of the Ammonites
Some of the plunder won in battles

questions.text: Under whose hand were the things dedicated by Samuel, Saul, Abner, and Joab?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:28 says all that they had dedicated was under the hand of Shelomoth and his brothers.

questions.text: Where were mighty men of valor found among the Hebronites in the fortieth year of David's reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:31 says mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

questions.text: Over whom did King David make Jerijah's two thousand seven hundred brothers overseers?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:32 says David made them overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites.

answers.text: The tribes of Judah, Benjamin, and Simeon in the south
The tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and Asher in the north
The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites
The tribes of Zebulun, Issachar, and Naphtali in the north
